production.note: US model years 2017-2024. First: FCA US introduced it as the 'All-new 2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio'. Last: the 2024 Quadrifoglio Super Sport was announced as "a fitting final chapter to the combustion engine Quadrifoglio in the U.S." (alfa-us-quadrifoglio-final-run-2024), and Alfa Romeo's 2026 Giulia specification sheet lists only the 2.0-litre cars (alfa-us-giulia-specs-2026). No opened page covers the 2025 lineup directly (the 'What's New for 2025' release could not be opened).

aspiration.note: 'Ferrari-derived 505-horsepower V-6 twin-turbo'; the specification sheet lists an 'Integrated IHI single-scroll turbo manifold with water charge air cooler'.

drivetrain.note: 'Giulia Quadrifoglio RWD'; all-wheel drive was offered only on the four-cylinder Giulia.

transmission.note: 'TRANSMISSION: 8HP75 EIGHT-SPEED AUTOMATIC' (ZF torque-converter automatic). The six-speed manual shown at the 2015 reveal (motorauthority-giulia-2015) was not on FCA US's 2017 fact sheet, which lists only the eight-speed automatic (alfa-us-giulia-factsheet-2017).

powerHp.note: Quote: "Power (SAE net) 505 hp (377 kW) @ 6,500 rpm (175 hp/liter)". Same row on the 2018 and 2019 sheets (alfa-us-giulia-specs-2018, alfa-us-giulia-specs-2019); 505 hp is also the figure in the 2015 launch release and the 2024 final-run release, so the rating never changed in the US.

weightLb.note: Sedan, 8-speed automatic (the only US transmission), 2020 model. Quote: "Curb Weight, lbs. (kg) ... 3,820 (1,733) – Giulia Quadrifoglio RWD". Reference year 2020 because it is the earliest Alfa Romeo US sheet found with a curb weight: the 2018 and 2019 sheets have no weight row, and the 2017 sheet could not be read. Pre-launch figures (3,360 lb in 2015, '3,600 Pounds (est.)' in 2016) were not final; see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Pre-launch figures versus the published curb weight. 3,360 lb (1,524 kg) is the figure FCA released at the November 2015 reveal, alongside a six-speed manual that was not sold in the US; Motor1's October 2016 first drive lists '3,600 Pounds (est.)'. Alfa Romeo's 2020 US specification sheet gives a curb weight of 3,820 lb for the Quadrifoglio.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,820 lb, the only manufacturer figure labelled curb weight for the US car as sold (eight-speed automatic).
